# Sea to Summit EU

> > Sea to Summit EU offers premium ultralight outdoor gear including sleeping bags, camping dinnerware, dry bags, hiking accessories, and tent equipment with climate-neutral shipping options.

Sea to Summit is a leading outdoor equipment brand specializing in innovative, lightweight gear for camping, hiking, and adventure travel. The European site serves customers across Germany, Austria, and France with products featuring materials like TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) and Ultra-Dry Down insulation, backed by a 5-year guarantee and eco-conscious shipping through DHL GoGreen and GLS Klima Protect.

## Key Topics

- Ultralight camping gear
- TPU waterproof cases and accessories
- Down and synthetic sleeping bags
- Collapsible camping dinnerware
- Dry bags and waterproof storage
- Hiking gaiters (Spinifex, Tumbleweed, Grasshopper)
- Tent accessories and gear lofts
- Climate-neutral shipping (DHL GoGreen, GLS Klima Protect)
- Reflective cords and gear straps
- Cold weather insulation
- Ultra-Sil lightweight products
- RDS certified down insulation
- 5-year product guarantee
- Outdoor dining equipment
